steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons P300‑single channel electronic pipette (GEN2), Opentrons P20‑multi‑channel electronic pipette (GEN2), Opentrons 20 µL filter tips, Opentrons 200 µL filter tips, and the Opentrons aluminum block set.

steps.title: Set up robot deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the Opentrons instructions, placing each 96‑well aluminum block on the deck and ensuring that every block contains at least four PCR strip tubes. Remember that the protocol is designed for a minimum of 24 samples.
